# Precursor Property

> Independent property due diligence reports for buyers and small developers across Victoria, Australia. We research a property from primary sources (title, planning, sales evidence) and deliver a plain-English report with a clear verdict, before you sign or bid. Fixed fee from A$99, delivered in 24 to 72 hours.

Precursor closes the information gap in a property purchase: the vendor and agent know the covenants, overlays, sale history and real yield; the buyer usually gets a brochure and a fifteen-minute inspection. Reports are researched and written by a human analyst, not generated by an algorithm, and are shaped to the property and the client's brief so sections and depth vary. Precursor is independent: it does not sell property, take referral fees, or earn commission on a purchase.

Precursor provides independent research and analysis, not personal financial, investment, or legal advice.

## Reports

- [Purchase Intelligence](https://precursorproperty.com.au/reports/purchase): Due diligence for buyers and investors. Title and encumbrances, zoning and overlays, comparable sales, rental yield, capital growth signals, vendor intelligence, negotiation strategy. Quick Screen from A$99; Full Due Diligence A$249.
- [Development Intelligence](https://precursorproperty.com.au/reports/development): Feasibility for owners and small developers. Zoning and residential code, subdivision potential, overlay constraints, permit pathway, margin modelling, council approval probability. Site Check from A$149; Full Feasibility A$399.
- [Pricing](https://precursorproperty.com.au/pricing): Fixed fees, no subscription. Money-back guarantee on a first order.
- [Sample report](https://precursorproperty.com.au/sample-report.html): A complete, real Full Due Diligence report (Montmorency VIC), republished with permission and with identifying details withheld.

## About

- [Our Method](https://precursorproperty.com.au/method): Why Precursor exists, the primary data sources used (VicPlan, Landata, council records, licensed sales data), and the honest boundary that reports are desktop research, not physical inspections.
- [FAQ](https://precursorproperty.com.au/faq): How reports differ from a building inspection or conveyancer, turnaround, data sources, confidentiality, and how each report adapts to the property.
- [Order a report](https://precursorproperty.com.au/order): Three-step order form; payment via Stripe.

## Insights (guides)

- [Property tax & budget changes for Victorian investors in 2026](https://precursorproperty.com.au/blog/victorian-property-tax-changes-2026): Negative gearing (proposed), the foreign-buyer ban, land tax, VRLT, and the short-stay and ESVF levies. What is law and what is not.
- [Victoria's 2026 rental reforms](https://precursorproperty.com.au/blog/victoria-rental-reforms-2026): No-fault evictions abolished, 90-day rent notices, minimum standards, portable bonds, and a proposed rent freeze.
- [Victorian property capital growth in 2026](https://precursorproperty.com.au/blog/victoria-capital-growth-2026): Current medians, divergent bank forecasts, and the corridors growing 6 to 10 percent while the average sits near 2.
- [Zoning explained for Victorian buyers](https://precursorproperty.com.au/blog/zoning-explained-for-victorian-buyers): NRZ, GRZ, RGZ, the 2025 reforms, and what decides whether you can build or subdivide.
- [Planning overlays in Victoria](https://precursorproperty.com.au/blog/planning-overlays-victoria-explained): Flood, bushfire and heritage overlays that can restrict a build even in a good zone.
- [Section 32 red flags](https://precursorproperty.com.au/blog/section-32-red-flags-victoria): Easements, owners-corporation debts, unpermitted works and outstanding charges to check in a vendor statement.
